hip_half_excursion_provenance: FIGURE_DIGITIZED_APPROX from Fig S27 dashed hip target ~-0.1..1.1rad; not a published numeric command table
hip_midpoint_provenance: DESIGN_ASSUMPTION: CAD means -90deg + offsets (fore +30deg, hind +15deg), preserving +/-0.6rad source excursion. Exact encoder-to-CAD zero unavailable; native screening evidence recorded separately.
phase_origin_definition: Maximum extension = maximum(fore torso angle - hind torso angle); next minimum is maximum flexion and onset of extension
fore_phase_offset_provenance: DESIGN_ASSUMPTION: paired fore/hind hip signals share phase in the existing same-direction leg coordinates; sequential source footfalls do not fix the servo phase. This also sets the separately prescribed fore-knee phase.
knee_provenance: PRESCRIBED_ASSUMPTION retained within previously sampled knee range; source physical knee trace unavailable and winding angle is not directly a loaded knee angle
wheel_provenance: Existing CAD route-supported interval; independent prescribed take-up command, not inverse loaded equilibrium
